cs.t: I dodged the Atom and picked up an Acer 1810tz. 4gb RAM, intel U4100 CPU, ran rings around netbooks at the time and I still use it here and there to this day. Probably the best keyboard I've ever used on such a small device.
cs.th: Breaking BIOS: enabling VT-x virtualization support on Acer Aspire One netbook
